settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceHelp: Voice commands stay off until you press this button. You can say a command in this language or in English. This needs Chrome and an internet connection. The microphone is on only while the status says so.
settings.commandsSaved: You left voice commands on. The microphone stays off until you press the button on this visit.
settings.resetHelp: Turns off high contrast, text size, the dyslexia font, line spacing, read on hover, the large cursor, and link highlighting.
settings.resetDone: Display settings are back to the start.
settings.readHoverHelp: Off until you turn it on. Resting the pointer on a paragraph reads that paragraph.

info.label: About {name}
info.textSize: Makes the text on this page bigger or smaller, from 100 to 200 percent.
info.contrast: Shows the page with white text and yellow links on black, so it is easier to see.
info.dyslexia: Changes the page font to one with clear, simple letter shapes that many people find easier to read.
info.spacing: Makes the space between lines of text bigger or smaller, so each line is easier to follow.
info.cursor: Makes the mouse pointer much bigger, so it is easier to see and follow.
info.links: Marks every link on this page with a yellow background and a thick underline, so links are easy to find.
info.readSelected: Select some text on the page, then press this to hear it read aloud.
info.stopReading: Stops any reading aloud right away.
info.voiceCommands: Lets you control this page by speaking: open the assistant or the accessibility tools, read the page, scroll, change the display, and more. You do not need to say every word: a short part of a command, like "open", is enough.
info.area: Uses your location once to suggest a language spoken in your area. You choose whether to switch.
info.clear: Deletes everything this assistant saved on this device, turns the settings back to the start, and stops the microphone and screen sharing.
